correct_completion: instead presenting the story as a fragmented mosaic of voices.
full_sentence: The novel abandons linear time, instead presenting the story as a fragmented mosaic of voices.
acceptable_variants: replacing chronology with a patchwork of competing voices.
and rather presents the plot as a broken collage of narrators.

options.text: in favour of a plain chronological account.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, because a chronological account is exactly what abandoning linear time rejects.

options.text: to present the story as one solid timeline.
options.why_wrong: An infinitive does not express the alternative to the abandoned structure in a grammatical way with the main clause.

options.text: though it presents the story chronologically.
options.why_wrong: The concessive clause contradicts the stem, which says the novel rejects chronology.

options.text: instead presenting the story as a fragmented mosaic of voices.

grammar_focus: Participle clauses used to describe the alternative to a rejected narrative technique
explanation: The '-ing' participle clause after 'instead' describes what the novel does in place of the rejected structure. It is a common pattern in literary criticism and it keeps the analysis compact. Learners whose first language is Russian often add a finite verb after 'instead', which makes the clause unbalanced.
translation: Роман отказывается от линейного времени, вместо этого представляя историю как фрагментарную мозаику голосов.
